qs.q: A newborn examination is performed. The tympanic membranes are visualized bilaterally. What is the embryologic origin of the structure that forms the canal connecting the external ear to the tympanic membrane?
qs.e: The external auditory canal is a derivative of the first pharyngeal cleft (groove).
